title: The fast-path page carries the rep
change: The page the recorder sends now shows Northwind's logo, the headline Dana, a quick video for Acme Freight, Alex Morgan's name and photo, the video, one Book a call button and a quiet Sent with Clarity line. All of it comes from the profile and the recorder's one question, with no visit to the editor.
evidence: Today the six-click path sends a bare video titled Untitled Video with no name, face, button or footer. 70% of new customer pages in the last 30 days are only a video.
notes: Uses the renderer's own stylesheet and hero markup; the sender line and the footer are two new rules written in the same style. The video is the renderer's click-to-play poster; the Mux control bar in the before only appears after play. The rep photo and the logo are stand-ins.
